title: Vaishnavism Saints: Dnyaneshwar (Dhaneswar)
definition: Sant Dnyaneshwar (1275–1296) was a 13th-century Marathi saint, poet, and philosopher of the Varkari tradition, best known for his commentary on the Bhagavad Gita, the 'Dnyaneshwari'.
importanceInUpsc: UPSC frequently tests the Bhakti movement's regional variations; Dnyaneshwar is central to understanding the socio-religious evolution of Maharashtra and the democratization of knowledge through vernacular literature.
learningOutcomes: Master foundational concepts and mechanisms of Vaishnavism Saints Dhaneswar.
Evaluate spatial distribution, institutional frameworks, and policy dimensions.
